verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Semgrep Code (SAST), Secrets, and Supply Chain (dependency/OSS SCA) scanning of source repositories, CI pipelines, and manifests, but contains no mention of scanning container images or detecting OS-package vulnerabilities inside image layers — a capability offered by dedicated container scanners. Since Semgrep explicitly compares itself to AppSec competitors (Checkmarx, Snyk) that do offer this, the axis is a fair comparison point but no evidence shows Semgrep delivers it.
